mapper.select: select MAX(case_no) from case_info where case_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
SELECT * FROM `case_info` WHERE apply_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH);

SELECT a.court_time, a.court, b.case_info_id, b.case_name, b.litigation_status, c.customer_name FROM `case_hearing` a LEFT JOIN case_info b ON b.case_info_id = a.case_info_id LEFT JOIN case_customer c ON c.case_info_id = b.case_info_id WHERE a.court_time >= DATE_SUB( CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH );
